title: Music and creating a theme across songs
author: Fox_mallow
selftext:
Has anyone had success creating songs that sound quite different from one another but still share a common musical theme? I'm talking specifically about the melody, rather than just reusing the same instruments or sounds, a motif (had to look that up because I only took music briefly in highschool) that I can use to attach to other tracks but render them in a different way

What software or tools are you using to achieve this, and what does your workflow look like?

An example of what I'm trying to achieve is the soundtrack from *Wanderstop*. The composer takes a particular melodic section from the main theme and carries it through several different tracks. The songs have different instruments, tempos, moods, and arrangements, but you can still recognize that recurring melody. It gives the soundtrack a shared musical identity without making every track sound the same.

wanderstop 1: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kMOOt2X5OT8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kMOOt2X5OT8) \- 0:20–0:39

wanderstop 2: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRvO6rQVolw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NRvO6rQVolw) \- 1:02–1:20

wanderstop 3: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XZilog7sI6I](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XZilog7sI6I) \- 0:40–1:03

Farewell: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oIC1-gwNpv4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oIC1-gwNpv4) \- 0:00-1:11 (the same melodic idea is stretched out over a much longer section)

I also tried to find some parts of the game where he used it for character interaction or environment background music but theres a lot to go through so Ill try to pick it out later.

I know this was all composed and arranged by hand, but I'm curious whether anyone has found a good way to achieve something similar in their own workflow.

Ideally, I'd like to create a collection of songs that each have their own identity, while sharing a particular 10 25 second melodic motif that can be adapted to fit each track. Almost like having a musical building block that you can rework, rearrange, or integrate into completely different songs while still maintaining a recognizable connection between them.

Has anyone experimented with this? I'd especially love to hear about your process and the tools you use.
